name: Code Editor
description: Native file I/O: view, edit, create, insert. The ONLY skill that mutates files on disk. You are forbidden to write anything on the disk without laoding this skill.
trigger: Writing to disk: create, edit, insert, or view files with precise line-numbered operations.
not_this_if: Reading a PDF/image for content -> use file_uploader. Running a build -> use execute_command directly.
